maddeler.e:
أختلق (form VIII)
# أَخْتَلِقُ (ʔaḵtaliqu) /ʔax.ta.li.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# أُخْتَلَقُ (ʔuḵtalaqu) /ʔux.ta.la.qu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# أَخْتَلِقَ (ʔaḵtaliqa) /ʔax.ta.li.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# أُخْتَلَقَ (ʔuḵtalaqa) /ʔux.ta.la
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
